info.title: E621
info.description:
OpenAPI definition for E621's API. You can find the source [here](https://github.com/DonovanDMC/E621OpenAPI)
This document is intended to compliment E621's existing [API Documentation](https://e621.net/help/api).
If the api is not working, you can check this [Unofficial Status Page](https://status.e621.church).

get.description:
Fetching a dmail will not mark it as read. 
Unless the dmail is owned:
- The current user must be staff and the dmail must be to or from the automod
- The current user must be Moderator+ and a ticket must exist for the dmail
- The current user must be Admin+ and the dmail must be to or from Admin+
- The current user must be Staff and have a share key for the dmail
